name: Shard of Empowerment banishes itself to empower the champion by 2
notes: Shard of Empowerment's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed; it is seeded directly onto the field (REGALIA convention). Its ability is banish-self at zero reserve cost: a single CustomInput Activate click empowers the champion by 2 and moves the shard to myBanish. Empower() tags the champion's TurnEffects with the source card ID, EMPOWERED, and EMPOWER_PLUS_2.
